Quadratic sufficiency follows by exact centered weighted-ball reduction. Finite arithmetic is used only for the example, not to establish the universal theorem.

value.rationale: High-order entropy-preserving DG limiters naturally use positive nodal quadrature, fixed cell means, and radial corrections. The result sharply separates two different minimization principles—maximal preservation along a ray and globally smallest conservative weighted L2 modification—showing exactly when these coincide, the first nodal count where they can differ, and an exact Simpson-rule positive-state example. This is mathematically motivated by limiter correction size and does not infer PDE instability.
